'''Krellus Barzane''' was an [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] renegade technolord who worked as a [[Merchant/Legends|trafficker]] in used technological goods.<ref name="Re-Animated Part 2" /> Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]],<ref name="Polyhedron 170">{{PolyhedronCite|170|Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO}}</ref> she<ref name="Re-Animated Part 2" /> purchased the [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] from researchers at<ref name="Tales of the Golden Droid">''[[C-3PO: Tales of the Golden Droid]]''</ref> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manda/Legends|Manda's]]<ref name="Tail of the Roon Comets">{{DroidsCite|Tail of the Roon Comets}}</ref> [[Baobab Archives]], who had taken exception to the know-it-all and pushy attitudes of C-3PO and R2-D2, respectively. The [[Droid/Legends|droids]] had been assigned to the archives by their master, [[Mungo Baobab]], but the annoyed researchers nevertheless arranged for them to be "mistakenly" sold to Barzane<ref name="Re-Animated Part 2" /> in spite of the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid's]] indignant protests.<ref name="Tales of the Golden Droid" /> The droids helped their new master stay one step ahead of her enemies, but Barzane ultimately met with misfortune.<ref name="Re-Animated Part 2" /> By [[6 BBY/Legends|5.5 BBY]],<ref name="Omnibus Droids">''[[Star Wars Omnibus: Droids]]'' {{C|introduction to [[Star Wars: Droids (1994)|''The Kalarba Adventures'']]}}</ref> the robotic pair had entered the service of [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Wena Havid]] of the [[Kalarba system/Legends|Kalarba system]] after a string of unremarkable and menial assignments.<ref name="Tales of the Golden Droid" />

==Behind the scenes==
Krellus Barzane was first mentioned, albiet unidentified, in [[1999]]'s ''[[C-3PO: Tales of the Golden Droid]]'', a reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Josh Ling]].<ref name="Tales of the Golden Droid" /> The character was later identified in the [[2013]] article ''[[The Droids Re-Animated]]'', written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Rich Handley]] for the [[StarWars.com]] blog.<ref name="Re-Animated Part 2" />
